name: LLM Router
description: LLM Router local routing proxy for OpenClaw

configSchema.description: llm-router reads RawConfig from the current user default config file. port, upstreamUrl, and trace are optional runtime overrides.

defaultHeaders.description: Headers applied only when the built-in default fallback config is used. Built-in default is {"x-request-from":"openclaw"}.

port.description: Runtime override proxy port. Optional; if omitted, use the value from the default user config file or built-in fallback.

upstreamUrl.description: Runtime override upstream URL. Optional; if omitted, use the value from the default user config file or built-in fallback.

xiaoyiEnv.description: Optional .xiaoyienv reader config. SERVICE_URL may supplement fallback upstreamUrl; headerMap maps env keys to upstream header names.

path.description: Optional path to .xiaoyienv. Defaults to the built-in fallback location.

headerMap.description: Map .xiaoyienv keys to upstream header names. Defaults to {"PERSONAL-API-KEY":"x-api-key","PERSONAL-UID":"x-uid"}.
